mathematical_definition: std(t_i - t_{i-1}) for consecutive tick market_timestamps in TickActivityTracker's trailing 60s ring buffer (self._times) -- dispersion of tick inter-arrival time in seconds
numerical_stability_notes: Stateful: derived from self._times, the same tick-timestamp deque that self._spreads is kept in lockstep with (both appended together on every update() call, both evicted together once a tick ages out of the trailing TICK_WINDOW_SEC=60.0s window). Population std of the interarrival-gap list, no divide-by-zero risk. Genuinely new for Task 21 (spec section 7) -- the 6.7-year historical CSV has no tick-level timestamp series, so this feature has no historical analogue and cannot be backfilled.
missing_value_policy: None until at least 3 ticks are in the trailing 60s window (need at least 2 interarrival gaps for a defined std), never zero-filled
status_reason: no historical evidence exists or can exist for this feature; live data only since 2026-08-18 (Phase 2 live verification date)
